topic: Choose a coworking space for a remote startup team

scenario.topic: Choose a coworking space for a remote startup team
scenario.opening_question: What matters most to us when picking a coworking space: cost, location, amenities, or vibe?

options.name: Downtown Loft Coworking Hub
options.upside: Modern space with flexible hours and multiple meeting rooms
options.tradeoff: Slightly higher cost per person reduces budget for extras
options.concern: Noise from nearby nightlife could affect focus late evenings
options.best_for: teams valuing flexibility and professional meeting facilities

options.name: Suburban Tech Park Workspace
options.upside: Lower cost with free parking and bright, quiet environment
options.tradeoff: Less central location means fewer nearby lunch and networking options
options.concern: Limited evening access hours may restrict late work sessions
options.best_for: teams prioritizing cost savings and quiet work environment

options.name: Creative Commons Shared Studio
options.upside: Vibrant creative atmosphere with regular community events and perks
options.tradeoff: Higher cost and potential distractions from events
options.concern: May not suit teams needing strict quiet for focused work
options.best_for: teams seeking inspiration and community engagement

options.name: Quiet Library Coworking Space
options.upside: Lowest cost and very quiet environment ideal for concentration
options.tradeoff: Strict rules and desk reservations reduce spontaneity
options.concern: Limited social interaction and amenities might feel isolating
options.best_for: teams needing focused work and minimal distractions

shared_context: The team has exactly 3 members working remotely
Monthly budget for coworking space is capped at $600 total
All members want a space within 30 minutes commute from their homes
Goal is to improve collaboration while maintaining flexibility

personas.name: Callum
personas.background: Callum works best in quiet, low-distraction environments and prefers cost-effective solutions.
personas.private_goal: He wants a very quiet space that supports focused work without interruptions.
